name: fabric-cli
description: Connect to, read, and modify anything in Fabric via the CLI, with a Fabric explorer pane that follows what fab does.

glyphs.title: Glyphs
glyphs.description: Icon set: auto uses FabricSymbols when the font is installed and your terminal started after it was installed, else Nerd Font, else plain Unicode; Nerd Font over SSH, plain Unicode in the desktop app. Pick one to force it.
